title: High-Level Leadership
audience: Ministers, state ministers, directors general, commissioners, bureau heads and equivalent senior executives

questions.text: He/She set and communicates a clear vision for the organization/units.
He/She provides clear strategic direction.
He/She considers the broader economic, social and environmental implications of decisions.
He/She ensures alignment between policy, strategy, programs and resources.
He/She ensures the development of clear and realistic strategic and operational plans.
He/She monitors and evaluates regularly the implementation of the strategic and operational plan according to the stated performance targets.
He/Shes put in place working relationship with diverse stakeholders
He/She effectively coordinates across departments and institutions.
He/She makes evidence- based decisions on major strategic and institutional issues.
He/She anticipates emerging national and sectoral challenges.
He/She creates an enabling environment for institutional transformation.
He/She effectively represents the institution.
He/She makes decisions in a timely manner.
He/She holds senior managers accountable for results.
He/She promotes institutional learning and innovation.
He/She ensures that institutional reforms produce measurable improvements.
He/She establishes working system to motivate the entire employees to perform effectively.
He/She provides useful feedback on performance.
He/She ensures accountability, transparency and integrity
He/She promotes the use of modern technologies to improve performance.
He/She follows up the utilization of financial resources efficiently and effectively across the system
He/She displays self-exemplary in improving personal leadership competence and put in place a working procedure to improve the competence of others
He/She promotes coaching and mentorship to enhance employee development
